relationships.description: Thrown inside an operation, caught at its boundary.
Run catches it and returns its status and diagnostics as a result.
Every operation answers with a UtvResult.
RequireStructural runs ValidateStructural on every argument first.
ReadCivil reads a civil envelope into one.
Instants and second amounts are exact rationals.
RequireDate checks the day against DaysInMonth.
Throws malformed-value, day-out-of-range, field-out-of-range, leap-second and the like.
The kind of zone the value carries.
Floor division keeps negative years and days right.
